title: ReceiptPayload_v1_1
description: RFC 8785 JCS-Canonicalized Cryptographic Receipt Schema v1.1 featuring Decision Reproducibility via Attestation Closure (IETF draft-sharif-agent-audit-trail-03 §13.6), Five-Verdict Relying-Party Sufficiency (IETF draft-schrock-ep-action-evidence-graph-00), and Hardware-Rooted Attestation (IETF RATS / arXiv:2608.00801).

version.description: Semantic version of the receipt payload specification. v1.1.0 introduces attestation closure and relying-party sufficiency.

action_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the tool dispatch / action.

leaf_index.description: 0-based leaf ordinal of this receipt in the Merkle audit log.

tree_size.description: Total number of committed leaves in the Merkle tree at checkpoint time (leaf_index < tree_size).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of receipt issuance.

intent_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical action input / tool parameters.

verdict.description: Six-disposition precedence cascade classification from the agent harness perspective.

relying_party_verdict.description: IETF draft-schrock-ep-action-evidence-graph-00 §4.2 five-verdict closed set evaluated from the relying party (bank / auditor / regulator) perspective.

root_hash.description: SHA-256 Merkle root digest over tree_size committed leaves.

inclusion_proof.description: RFC 9162 Merkle audit path hashes demonstrating leaf membership.

attestation_closure.description: Decision Reproducibility via Attestation Closure per IETF draft-sharif-agent-audit-trail-03 §13.6. Seals model weights, tokenizer, prompt template, engine binary, and numeric backend.

model_weights_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the base model weights tensor checkpoint (e.g. safetensors).

tokenizer_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of tokenizer.json and vocabulary files.

chat_template_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the chat/prompt Jinja template formatting instructions.

engine_build_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the inference engine binary/runtime build.

inference_config_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of generation config parameters (temperature, top_p, seed).

numeric_environment_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of compute backend, CUDA/Metal kernel versions, and precision parameters.

hardware_attestation.description: Hardware-Rooted Attestation bindings per IETF RATS and arXiv:2608.00801.

tpm_quote.description: Base64 or hex TPM 2.0 PCR quote signed by the Attestation Identity Key (AIK).

sev_snp_measurement.description: AMD SEV-SNP launch measurement or Intel TDX Quote.

enclave_measurement.description: AWS Nitro Enclave or Apple Secure Enclave attestation document.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature hex string over RFC 8785 JCS-canonicalized receipt payload.

signer_pubkey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key hex of the authorized attestor.
